title: QR code fuel system to be implemented from today
byline: The government has decided to implement the National Fuel Authorization System using QR codes for fuel distribution with effect from 6.00 a.m. today (March 15), the Ministry of Energy announced.

title: Swiss reject two flyover requests from US for flights related to Iran war, permits three others
byline: The Swiss ​government said on Saturday that ‌it discussed requests by U.S. military and official aircraft to fly over the country, ​and based on its law ​of neutrality, rejected two Iran-related war ⁠flights but permitted three others.

title: Namal calls for regional dialogue after Iranian ship sinking near Sri Lanka
byline: Sri Lankan politician Namal Rajapaksa has called for stronger regional cooperation after the sinking of an Iranian ship near Sri Lankan waters, warning that the incident could threaten stability in the Indian Ocean.

title: F1 cancels Bahrain & Saudi Arabia Grands Prix
byline: The Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grand Prix weekends in April have been cancelled as a result of the war in the Middle East.

title: Trump urges UK and other nations to send warships to Strait of Hormuz
byline: Donald Trump has urged the UK and other nations to send warships to the Strait of Hormuz to help secure the key shipping route out of the Middle East.

title: US, China economic chiefs to meet in Paris to clear path to Trump-Xi summit
byline: Top U.S. and Chinese economic officials are set to launch a new round of talks in Paris on Sunday to iron out kinks in their trade truce and clear a ​smooth path for U.S. President Donald Trump’s trip to Beijing to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping at the end of March.

title: Sri Lanka Fuel QR Code System: Complete Guide to Register, Download and Fuel Quotas
byline: This guide explains how the QR code fuel system works, how to register your vehicle, how to download your QR code, and the weekly fuel limits for different types of vehicles.

title: Fuel queues return as QR code system relaunched today
byline: Long queues were reported at several filling stations across Sri Lanka today after the Government reintroduced the National Fuel Pass (QR code) system with effect from 6.00 a.m.

title: Iran’s foreign minister says there is no problem with supreme leader
byline: Iran’s foreign minister said Saturday that there was “no problem” with the Islamic Republic’s new supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei after US officials reported he was wounded.

title: Govt working to resolve issues with fuel QR code system
byline: The Department of Government Information said that steps are already being taken to quickly address issues that have arisen following the reintroduction of the fuel QR code system.

title: Trump says Iran is ready to negotiate a ceasefire but he’s not ready to make a deal
byline: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he’s not ready to make a deal to end the war with Iran despite the country’s willingness to do so “because the terms aren’t good enough yet,” but declined to say what those terms would be.

title: Govt considers work-from-home to save fuel
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake held a high-level discussion today with Ministry Secretaries and Heads of Institutions to address the challenges in maintaining essential services following the escalating conflict in the Middle East.

title: Sri Lanka Navy’s conducts deep-sea drug raid
byline: The Sri Lanka Navy has carried out another successful deep-sea drug raid, apprehending five suspects and seizing a local multi-day fishing vessel carrying a suspected drug container off the southern coast near Dewundara.

title: Public advised on steps to obtain fuel under restored QR system
byline: The Ministry of Digital Economy has issued a public notice outlining the process for obtaining fuel following the full restoration of the National Fuel Pass (QR) system.

title: No fuel shortage despite QR system, CPC says
byline: Despite the introduction of the QR code system for fuel distribution, there is no fuel shortage in the country, said Managing Director of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation, Mayura Neththikumara.

title: Bank closures reported across Gulf countries after Iran warns civilians to stay 1 km away
byline: Some international banks in the Middle East have shut branches and evacuated offices after Iran warned that banks and economic centres linked to the United States and Israel could become targets.

title: Cultural Affairs Ministry fails to come up with  auspicious times for Sinhala Tamil New Year: Opposition MP
byline: The Ministry of Cultural Affairs has failed to come up with a proper timetable which outlines auspicious times for various activities in connection with the Sinhala and Tamil New Year traditions, MP Ajith P. Perera told a briefing today.

title: US, China economic chiefs to meet in Paris to clear path to Trump-Xi summit
byline: Top U.S. and Chinese economic officials are set to launch a new round of talks in Paris on Sunday to iron out kinks in their trade truce and clear a ​smooth path for U.S. President Donald Trump’s trip to Beijing to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping at the end of March.

title: Some MPs used state-funded overseas trips for shopping, U.S. Chief Sanghanayake claims
byline: The Chief Judicial Sanghanayake of the United States and Chief Incumbent of the Maryland International Buddhist Temple, Katugastota Uparathana Thera said he had previously met several Members of Parliament and ministers who had gone shopping during official overseas visits at the expense of public funds.

title: Israel says it is planning at least three more weeks of military campaign in Iran
byline: IDF Spokesman Brig. Gen. Effie Defrin says the Israeli military has plans for at least three more weeks of operations in Iran, during which thousands of targets would be struck.

title: UK looking at all options to secure Strait of Hormuz, says Miliband
byline: The UK is looking at ’’any options’’ - including working with the US and allies - to secure key oil shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz, Ed Miliband has said.
